title: Finite-Step Bounds for Iterated Correlation Matrices
summary: We establish finite-step probabilistic upper bounds on the contraction ratios $ρ_k = Δ_{k+1}/Δ_k$ for iterated Pearson correlation dynamics. Let $(P_k)_{k\ge 0}$ be the sequence generated by the Pearson update. Define $Δ_k := \|P_{k+1}-P_k\|_F$, $ρ_k := Δ_{k+1}/Δ_k$ for $Δ_k > 0$, and $δ_k := Δ_k/n$. Although $Δ_k \to 0$ along convergent trajectories, the ratios $ρ_k$ may exceed unity in finitely many steps. This behavior is invisible to local linearization.
